about.title: About Cattleya
about.p1: The Cattleya B&B takes its name from a tropical flower symbolizing elegance, beauty and hospitality.
about.p2: Like this rare and fascinating flower, we want to offer our guests a special place in the heart of Milano: a warm, well-kept environment with an almost familiar atmosphere, where you can immediately feel at home.
about.p3: Choosing Cattleya means experiencing Milano with the comfort, tranquility and attention that only authentic hospitality can offer.

location.title: Location
location.preview: Cattleya Bed & Breakfast is located in the heart of the NoLo district, in northeast Milano, at via Perticari, on the corner of via Padova, a lively and multicultural street full of all kinds of venues: restaurants, shops, supermarkets, pharmacies and banks.
location.intro: Cattleya Bed & Breakfast is located in the heart of the NoLo district, in northeast Milano, at via Perticari, on the corner of via Padova, a lively and multicultural street full of all kinds of venues: restaurants, shops, supermarkets, pharmacies and banks. It is 400 meters from the Cimiano metro station (Green Line) and just a short walk from the Martesana Park. It is 2 km from the entrance to the Milano East Ring Road, which provides quick access to the airports of Linate (now also reachable via the M4 metro) and Orio al Serio.
location.transport: This strategic location allows you to conveniently reach the city center in just a few minutes thanks to frequent metro connections that quickly take you to areas of great interest such as the Duomo, Brera and Porta Venezia.
location.hospital: The property is located near the San Raffaele Hospital, easily reachable in 15 minutes, making it ideal for those traveling for health reasons.
location.park: The immediate proximity to the Martesana Park offers the opportunity to enjoy pleasant walks, cycling paths and moments of relaxation surrounded by greenery.

metro.distance: Only 400 meters from the Cattleya B&B
metro.direction: Direction Cascina Gobba / Gessate / Cologno Nord

cattleya.name: CATTLEYA
cattleya.description: The Cattleya room is located on the top floor of a building with an elevator and enjoys a splendid view of the Milano skyline. It is equipped to accommodate up to 2 people, thanks to a comfortable French-style sofa bed. The room, furnished in a modern style, features a kitchenette, private bathroom, and a large terrace, ideal for moments of relaxation. The apartment is equipped with all the main comforts: TV, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and mosquito screens, to ensure a pleasant stay in every season. The kitchenette is complete with a refrigerator, microwave, two induction plates, kettle, dishes, and pots. The private bathroom is equipped with a large shower, hairdryer, and washing machine.

matcha.name: MATCHA
matcha.description:
This charming 30 sqm studio apartment is located on the 6th floor of a building with an elevator and enjoys a splendid view of the Milano skyline, over the rooftops of old Milano near Via Padova and the Naviglio Martesana, all the way to the new skyline of Piazza Gae Aulenti with the Unicredit Tower, the tallest skyscraper in Italy, and further to the Madonnina of our Duomo.
The studio, equipped with all comforts, television, air conditioning and Wi-Fi, features a large room furnished in modern style. The property can accommodate 2 people: the single beds can become a comfortable double bed.
A kitchenette is fully equipped with a refrigerator, microwave, and two induction plates. The furnishings include a console table, a desk, a chest of drawers, chairs, an armchair, and a walk-in closet located in the bathroom anteroom. The windowed bathroom is equipped with a large shower, hairdryer, and courtesy products.
The highlight of the property is the terrace equipped with a table and chairs for outdoor dining, complete with a small veranda.

sakura.name: SAKURA
sakura.description: The Sakura room is a cozy and functional solution, ideal for hosting one person. Furnished in a modern style, it offers well-kept and bright spaces, designed to guarantee comfort and practicality during your stay. The room features a fully equipped kitchenette with a refrigerator, microwave, two induction plates, and kettle, perfect for preparing meals independently. The private bathroom is equipped with a shower, hairdryer, and courtesy kit. The accommodation also includes all the main comforts, including TV, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and mosquito screens. Completing the structure is a large terrace that represents an ideal space for moments of relaxation, making the Sakura room a perfect choice for both short stays and longer stays.
